svg.title: D1-060 card 9, step s2: output error against source resistance
svg.text: under 1 % of 3.3 V (proposal F4): R_s < 6.6 kΩ
3.3 V rail: above it the real output stops
V_o = G·I_b·R_s at G = 500. The ramp (s2) runs 1 kΩ → 100 kΩ: 5 mV → 0.5 V with nothing changed in the signal.
